name: Python
summary: From how computers work to building and shipping real programs, modeled on Harvard's CS50 and MIT's 6.100 and 6.006: lessons, worked examples, problem sets graded by real tests, quizzes, and a final project you defend.

levels.name: Data and structure: classes, modules, testing your own code
Systems: memory, files, networking, databases, concurrency
Mastering Python: idioms, the standard library, debugging, performance
Professional craft: git, design, code review, security, accessibility
Capstone: a real project for real people, then a defense

certs: Python Institute PCEP (entry level) after Level 1-2
